cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before we move the sofa: are we shrinking while the room stays normal, or is the room growing while we stay normal?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Shrinking means call full-sized help. Growing means hurry before the door gets farther away. Choose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him to bring tweezers. He'll need to collect us afterward.

mechanism: A commands B to choose a reality model and then directs the practical consequences of that authorized choice.
confusable: Unlike offering interchangeable fanciful explanations, each model requires a different next action and A commits the group to B's selection.
comparison: Moving a sofa while shrinking differs from serving a floating buffet before gravity returns.
seedUse: The seed already orders a choice and then instructions for the brother, making S01 control the decision process rather than replacing it.
